name: no-think-tags
description: Stop a final reply that leaks a raw reasoning tag block, and ask for one clean re-send.

interface.shortDescription: Keeps reasoning tags out of final replies.
interface.longDescription: A Stop hook that detects a reply opening with a raw <think>, <thinking>, or <thought> block and requests one bounded, clean re-send. Closing tags inside Markdown code are ignored, and the hook never re-fires inside the same correction turn.
